observed_failure.chrome_error: Companion refused the request. Check pairing and server status.
observed_failure.root_cause: scripts/run-observer.py parse_opencode assumed tool_use.state.input was an object; a malformed/truncated OpenCode tool call supplied a string and raised AttributeError.

fix.parser: Malformed non-object tool input is treated as empty metadata; the OC event remains observable and correlation survives.
fix.ui_semantics: Chrome distinguishes observer_unavailable as DEGRADED from true companion OFFLINE; 401 invalid pairing is also reported distinctly.
fix.live_acceptance: GET /bridge/observer?adapter=chrome returned HTTP 200 after the parser fix.

principle: Execution evidence is untrusted observer input. One malformed event must not collapse the observer plane.
